description_en: Queries a list of AI tasks
kebab_example: aliyun ros list-ai-tasks --next-token U12WEI6Ro2ol3wA54rBNS3Cltv2VJyA+7hP4GqbIOhmWU5mWU9ZE3cXLgDaH4KSMRfIYcIVrvtHaAzCoyfo7VQ== --max-results 50 --task-type GenerateTemplate --task-id t-asasas00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAITasks

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data entries to return
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The type of the AI task. You can filter AI tasks by task type.

GenerateTemplate: The AI task is used to generate a template.
FixTemplate: The AI task is used to fix a template.

If you leave this parameter empty, all task types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
过滤AI任务的类型。
GenerateTemplate：AI生成模板
FixTemplate：AI模板修复。

若不传则查询所有的任务类型
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI task. You can filter AI tasks by task ID
parameters.name: task_id

Message.example: You are not authorized to complete this action.

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_en: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the AI task was created. The time is displayed in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

Prompt.description_en: The description of the AI task
Prompt.example: Create an ECS instance and deploy an Nginx service

Status.description_en:
The state of the AI task.

PENDING
WAITING
RUNNING
SUCCESS
FAILURE
Status.description_zh:

PENDING
WAITING
RUNNING

StatusReason.description_en: The reason why the AI task is in the state

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the AI task

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the AI task was updated. The time is displayed in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format
UpdateTime.description_zh: 更新时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss
